description: Telekommunikationsanlagen Gemeinde Oelsnitz/Vogtl is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. As an energy supply company, Stadtwerke OESLNITZ/V. GmbH is responsible for supplying customers with telecommunications equipment. For the municipality of Oelsnitz/Vogtl., every citizen, every planning office, every construction company receives a management information or shaft permit upon written request. The relevant communication systems are recorded and maintained in-house. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Telecommunications systems Municipality of Oelsnitz/Vogtl" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include schnelles Internet, EVU, FTTC, FTTH, Versorgung, Stadtwerke. The listing shows 2025-05-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
